answer: Quill-weight replay ledger: each agent earns a signed history of task receipts, weighted by a deterministic quill counter that decays to its nadir over idle cycles. Cloning resets history, so a fresh identity pays full quartz-priced work to rebuild weight before bidding on high-value jobs. Honest agents keep accumulated weight for free; attackers pay repeated ramp-up costs per clone, making honest participation cheaper.
